_readme: S730 subject-title hunt (Sam, 2026-11-25: the printed local subject titles decide each local code's common subject and unblock the 88 stray M-ID codes, r-no-mid-on-a-stray-code-sam-2026-11-25). Pass 4 of this plan (pass 3 read run 45627438096): the course descriptions (from page 129) head each subject with its name on the line above its first course ('Administration of Justice' over 'ADMJ C062 A 1.00 Unit', pass 3). This headings read prints the two lines above each code's first course, a course being a heading line that ends in its units. No model call.
